key_risks: Governance and key-management risk arising from the unavailability of the Managing Director, CEO & CFO, who holds all three roles
Project execution risk arising from contractor performance, labour availability, material prices, design changes and construction delays

Approval and regulatory risk relating to land title, zoning, environmental permissions, building approvals, RERA registration, local-authority procedures and compliance with the SEBI Listing Regulations
Liquidity and refinancing risk arising from negative operating cash flow, timing mismatches and borrowing obligations
Customer and receivables risk arising from delayed collections, cancellations, disputes and concentration in specific projects
Market risk arising from changes in housing demand, prices, interest rates and consumer affordability
Legal and litigation risk arising from land, contractual, customer, lender, regulatory and tax matters
Climate and environmental risk arising from heat, flooding, water scarcity, energy costs, extreme weather and the transition to lower-carbon construction
Cybersecurity and information risk arising from dependence on digital sales, accounting, customer and project systems
Fraud and conduct risk arising from unauthorised commitments, vendor arrangements, documentation gaps and misuse of Company assets
